semiconductor_relevance: High — C&G Hi Tech Co., Ltd. provides critical infrastructure for semiconductor manufacturing through its Central Chemical Supply Systems.
summary: C&G Hi Tech Co., Ltd. specializes in the production of Central Chemical Supply Systems (CCSS), which are essential for delivering high-purity chemicals to semiconductor and display manufacturing facilities. The company serves major clients like Samsung Electronics and SK Hynix, and is also involved in developing next-generation materials such as Glass PCB and heat dissipation technologies.

regional_presence.Korea: C&G Hi Tech Co., Ltd. is based in Korea and serves major Korean semiconductor companies like Samsung Electronics and SK Hynix.
